name: avatar-group
title: Avatar Group
description: A compound component for displaying overlapping avatar stacks with an overflow indicator. Uses namespace exports: AvatarGroup.Root, AvatarGroup.Overflow.

docs.lead: A compound component for displaying overlapping avatar stacks with an overflow indicator.
docs.usage:
import * as AvatarGroup from "@/components/ui/avatar-group"
import * as Avatar from "@/components/ui/avatar"

<AvatarGroup.Root>
  <Avatar.Root>
    <Avatar.Image src="/path/to/image.png" />
  </Avatar.Root>
  <AvatarGroup.Overflow>+3</AvatarGroup.Overflow>
</AvatarGroup.Root>

examples.title: Size
examples.description: Avatar groups come in 9 sizes matching the Avatar sizes: 80 (default), 72, 64, 56, 48, 40, 32, 24, and 20. The size prop propagates to child Avatar.Root components.

api.name: AvatarGroup.Root
api.description: The main container that arranges avatars in an overlapping stack.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of all avatars in the group. Propagated to child Avatar.Root and AvatarGroup.Overflow components.

api.name: AvatarGroup.Overflow
api.description: A circular overflow indicator showing the count of additional avatars not displayed.
